title: Write a short design note (B1)
summary: Viết một ghi chú thiết kế ngắn gồm vấn đề, đề xuất và một rủi ro để đồng đội xem trước khi làm.
learningObjectives: Nêu vấn đề hiện tại bằng dữ kiện
Đề xuất một giải pháp đơn giản và nêu một đánh đổi
Nêu một rủi ro và cách giảm

sections.title: Design note request
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Request from the team lead. Topic: exports of large reports time out. Facts: exports with more than fifty thousand rows fail after thirty seconds; about one export in ten is that large; customers retry and increase the load. Idea to evaluate: run large exports in the background and send an email with a download link.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Giải pháp bạn muốn đội xem xét.
vocabulary.example: The proposal is to run exports in the background.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: pro-PO-sal.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Việc chạy sau, không làm người dùng chờ.
vocabulary.example: Large exports run as background jobs.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết liền thành backgroundjob. Dạng đúng là hai từ: background job.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Được cái này thì mất cái kia.
vocabulary.example: The trade-off is between speed and simplicity.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều có thể sai và ảnh hưởng đến kết quả.
vocabulary.example: The main risk is a full queue.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a risk of + danh từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Yêu cầu bị dừng vì chạy quá lâu.
vocabulary.example: Large exports fail with a timeout after thirty seconds.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói the export times out (động từ), không nói the export timeout.

expressions.example: Currently, large exports fail after thirty seconds. This causes retries and extra load.

expressions.meaning: Nêu đề xuất và lý do.
expressions.example: I propose that we run large exports in the background, because users do not need to wait.

expressions.phrase: The main risk is ___. We can reduce it by ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu rủi ro và cách giảm.
expressions.example: The main risk is a full queue. We can reduce it by limiting exports per user.

expressions.phrase: I would like your feedback on ___.
expressions.example: I would like your feedback on the email link and its expiry time.

exercises.question: Which sentence states the problem with facts?
options: Exports above fifty thousand rows fail after thirty seconds.
Exports are somewhat annoying for some people.
We should probably do something about exports.
correctAnswer: Exports above fifty thousand rows fail after thirty seconds.
exercises.explanation: Vấn đề nêu bằng con số cụ thể.

exercises.question: Sửa lỗi: câu "I propose to we run exports in the background." sai một từ. Điền từ đúng thay cho "to".
exercises.explanation: I propose that we + động từ.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp các phần của design note.
exercises.explanation: Vấn đề, đề xuất, rủi ro, xin góp ý.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
correctAnswer: background job - tác vụ chạy nền
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu (đề xuất): The ___ is to run exports in the background.
Điền từ còn thiếu (tác vụ chạy nền): Large exports run as ___.
exercises.explanation: "background job" nghĩa là tác vụ chạy nền.

performanceTask.title: Write a design note
performanceTask.scenario: Trưởng nhóm nhờ bạn viết một ghi chú thiết kế ngắn về xuất báo cáo lớn bị timeout.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Từ yêu cầu ngắn, hãy viết một design note bằng tiếng Anh (70 đến 120 từ): vấn đề, đề xuất và một rủi ro. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write a short design note in English, 70 to 120 words: the problem with facts, your proposal, one risk and how to reduce it.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Design note: large report exports. Currently, exports with more than fifty thousand rows fail after thirty seconds. About one export in ten is that large, and users retry, which increases the load. I propose that we run large exports as background jobs. We would send an email with a download link when the file is ready, because users do not need to wait on the page. The main trade-off is a more complex flow in exchange for fewer failures. The main risk is a full queue during busy hours. We can reduce it by limiting the number of exports per user. I would like your feedback on the link expiry time.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the note again in English. Keep the structure and make the problem more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write a design note for a different problem, such as users who receive the same alert twice, with the same structure.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write a design note for another problem without looking at old notes.

artifacts.title: Large report exports
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Request. Topic: exports above fifty thousand rows time out after thirty seconds. About one export in ten is that large. Idea: run large exports in the background and email a link.

retry.title: Slow search
retry.brief: Sửa bài với vấn đề tìm kiếm chậm.

artifacts.title: Slow search
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Request. Topic: search takes four seconds with two million products. Users leave after three seconds. Idea: add a search index and keep it updated every minute.

transfer.title: Duplicate notifications
transfer.brief: Tình huống mới: thông báo bị gửi trùng.

artifacts.title: Duplicate notifications
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Request. Topic: users receive the same alert twice, about two percent of alerts. Cause: retries after timeouts. Idea: store a unique key per alert.

review.title: Slow deployments
review.brief: Ôn lại với việc triển khai chậm.

artifacts.title: Slow deployments
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Request. Topic: deployments take twenty-five minutes and block releases. Most time is spent on tests that run one after another. Idea: run tests in parallel on four machines.

rubric.label: Problem, proposal, risk
rubric.description: The note has all three parts.

anchors.met: A reader sees facts, a proposal and one risk with a mitigation.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing or the problem has no facts.

anchors.met: Short sentences with correct verbs and numbers.
anchors.notMet: Long unclear sentences or wrong numbers.

rubric.label: Neutral professional tone
rubric.description: The tone suits a note to teammates.

anchors.met: Neutral, with a polite request for feedback.
